name: SVGS with Movable Kernels
definition: A Gaussian splatting variant that enhances scene representation by using spatially varying colors and opacity within a single primitive, specifically employing movable sub-kernels that adapt their positions during training.
summary: SVGS with Movable Kernels is a spatially varying function that uses learnable, gradient-driven kernel centers to adapt positions during training, offering higher flexibility than fixed-basis methods.
